name: vibeschool-execution-journal
description: Preserve durable, append-only mission provenance for consequential VibeSchool engineering actions and evidence.
---
# Execution Journal
Consequential mission events must carry mission/run identity, actor/tool, action, result, exact head/version, evidence/provenance and state transition in the canonical durable journal. Chat summaries are not mission state. Do not rewrite history to hide failed attempts; append repairs and invalidations. Journal integrity must survive agent/chat handoff and support replay, audit and stale-evidence diagnosis.
